{{Quote|The Jedi Council had received a distress call from Mana Veridi, a fellow Jedi who'd been sent to investigate a disturbance on ''Kwannot''. We were asked to offer her our assistance.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Once Bitten" />}}
The '''duel on Kwannot''' was a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] between [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] against the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] who had killed the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Mana Veridi]]. Both master and apprentice faced off against the assassin who gained the upper hand during their confrontation. But Sing fled and stole Veridi's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] when she realized that the two Jedi were more than she had anticipated.<ref name="Once Bitten" />

Kenobi later recalled this incident in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] to the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] onboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] en route to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Kenobi told Solo he liked to believe that Sing fled because she believed that Jinn and Kenobi were too powerful for her though that was just conjecture.<ref name="Once Bitten" />
